About me

I write technical content, including documentation, longform blog posts, and case studies, for early-stage B2B devtool startups.

I currently write technical marketing content (case studies and blog posts) at Extend (YC W23), plus some adhoc freelance work. Previously, I wrote developer documentation and technical marketing content for Fern (W23). Before that, I wrote internal developer documentation for Google. Here’s my resume.

My portfolio contains a selection of my work; my GitHub profile is a better indicator of how much I write. The rest of this site contains random musings I write in my free time.

In my free time, I read a lot. The best book I’ve read so far in 2026 is The English Understand Wool (2022) by Helen DeWitt, followed closely by The Romance of a Shop (1888) by Amy Levy.
